name: Interview Synthesis
description: Turn a corpus of interviews into traceable themes, contradictions, cases, and implications without laundering anecdotes into universal truth.

tasks.name: Prepare interview corpus
tasks.objective: Confirm consent/use boundaries, anonymization needs, participant/context metadata, transcript quality, interviewer notes, research questions, and sampling limitations.

tasks.name: Build initial coding frame
tasks.objective: Create descriptive and interpretive codes tied to the research question, define inclusion/exclusion criteria, and leave room for emergent codes rather than forcing every answer into the opening theory.

tasks.name: Code interviews
tasks.objective: Apply codes consistently, retain source references, memo ambiguities, mark contradictions and negative cases, and distinguish participant statement from analyst interpretation.

tasks.name: Develop themes and cases
tasks.objective: Group related patterns into themes, compare across relevant contexts, identify mechanisms or tensions, preserve outliers, and test candidate themes against disconfirming excerpts.

tasks.name: Build evidence-backed claims
tasks.objective: For each synthesis claim, attach representative and contradictory excerpts, participant/context coverage, confidence, alternative interpretations, and limitations.

tasks.name: Produce synthesis artifact
tasks.objective: Deliver themes, case patterns, journey or conceptual models where useful, evidence tables, quote bank with permissions, unresolved questions, sampling caveats, and implications explicitly separated from observations.
